segments.text: He does not stop. He does not stop to breathe.
segments.speaker: SOLDIER

segments.text: Fall back to the second line. The second line. Do you hear me?
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Brother. Look at the ground.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: I am looking.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: No. Look at it.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: Drona.
segments.speaker: SAGE

segments.text: I know it.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: You were given the celestial weapons on a condition. You know the condition.
segments.speaker: SAGE

segments.text: They are not to be used against men who cannot answer them. You are using them on farmers. On boys.
segments.speaker: SAGE

segments.text: Yes.
segments.speaker: DRONA
segments.note: long pause before this line, quiet

segments.text: This is not war any longer. You have crossed out of it.
segments.speaker: SAGE

segments.text: Lay down the bow, Drona. You have done what you came to do and more than what you came to do. Lay it down and come with us.
segments.speaker: SAGE

segments.text: How many.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: We have stopped counting. That is not a figure of speech. The men who were counting are dead.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Then we go at him together. All of us, at once, and some of us do not come back, and it is finished.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: He has the Brahmastra on the string, Bhima. Together means we die in one place instead of five.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: He cannot be beaten while he is holding that bow.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: Then we have no course.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: I said while he is holding it.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: Say what you mean.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Drona has one weakness and he has never hidden it. He has never needed to. Take away his reason to hold the bow and the bow comes down on its own.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: Ashwatthama is on the north flank. He is not even wounded.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Drona does not need him to be dead. Drona needs to believe he is dead.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: No.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Arjuna.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: He taught me to hold a bow. He put my hands on it. You are asking me to break an old man by lying to him about his son.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: I am telling you what is true. Whether you use it is yours.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: There is an elephant in Indravarma's line called Ashwatthama.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: The Malava king named it after him. It was meant as flattery.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: He will not believe Bhima. He will not believe me. He will not believe any of you.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: I know who he will believe.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: No.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: Then the war ends today, and not in our favour, and everything spent to get here is spent for nothing.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: No.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: Twelve thousand this morning. I saw them go.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: Brother.
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Bhima.
segments.speaker: KRISHNA

segments.text: I will go.
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: ASHWATTHAMA IS DEAD!
segments.speaker: BHIMA
segments.note: roaring, carrying across a huge distance

segments.text: ASHWATTHAMA IS DEAD! ASHWATTHAMA IS DEAD!
segments.speaker: BHIMA

segments.text: Bhima.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: Bhima says it. Bhima would say anything.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: Yudhishthira.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: Acharya.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA

segments.text: I have taught a great many people. Most of them I taught to shoot.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: I taught you as well, and you were not the best of them, and we both know it. You were something else.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: In your whole life you have never told me an untruth. Not when you were nine and it would have saved you a beating. Not once.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: So I am going to ask you, and then I am going to go back to my line and finish this, one way or the other.
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: Is my son dead?
segments.speaker: DRONA

segments.text: Ashwatthama is dead.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA
segments.note: clear, level, projected — this half should sound designed to carry

segments.text: The elephant.
segments.speaker: YUDHISHTHIRA
segments.note: quieter, dropped in volume, NOT a whisper — almost swallowed

segments.text: TAKE HIM ALIVE!
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: He is unarmed! He is sitting down! Take him alive, that is an order, take him ALIVE!
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: DHRISHTADYUMNA!
segments.speaker: ARJUNA
segments.note: shouting, four repetitions, growing more desperate each time

segments.text: DHRISHTADYUMNA, NO!
segments.speaker: ARJUNA

segments.text: Three! That is three!
segments.speaker: ASHWATTHAMA

segments.text: What is that noise?
segments.speaker: ASHWATTHAMA

segments.text: Somebody has won something small and wants everyone to hear about it.
segments.speaker: ASHWATTHAMA
segments.note: dismissive, cheerful, already turning away — genuinely no dread in this line

segments.text: Let them. Let them count theirs. I will tell him mine tonight.
segments.speaker: ASHWATTHAMA
